approche.title: The Ping
approche.narrator: A steady signal underwater is an outstretched hand — or a lure.
approche.text:
You leave the mining terrace — episode 3 behind you, the portal still ahead.

The **ping** returns. Steady. Mechanical. **Every four seconds.**

Your HUD:

**450 m remaining · depth 360 m · lamp 18% · heading 214°**

You swim toward the signal. The cliff gives way to a **structure** — twisted pylons, crushed dome, broken sonar antenna pointing upward like a severed finger.

**RELAY N-7.** A Fableris mining station. Abandoned. Lit, somehow.

choices.text: Speed up — reach the station before the lamp fails
Switch off your sonar — avoid interference

station.title: Relay N-7
station.narrator: A station pulsing in the black draws those who search — and those who wait.
station.text:
You circle the dome.

**Emergency lights** blink underwater — sick green, faint. Not your lamp. Not the portal. Something else.

The ping comes **from inside**. Louder now. Each pulse makes your suit vibrate — resonance in your ribcage.

An access hatch: open. Water stable. No current.

Your lamp: **17%**.

interieur.title: Echo Chamber
interieur.narrator: In a sonar room, every wall returns a different version of the truth.
interieur.text:
You enter.

Dead consoles. Torn cables. And at the centre, the **emitter** — cracked sphere, still active, ping every four seconds.

Your sonar switches on **by itself**.

**Ping.** Target: **ahead of you**, 5 m.

You move forward. Nothing.

**Ping.** Target: **behind you**, 3 m.

**Ping.** Target: **everywhere**. Twelve contacts. Twenty. The HUD becomes a constellation of threats.

The radio:

*« —{{player}}… don't trust the relay… shut it down… — »*

Static — drowned by the next ping.

mensonge.title: False Map
mensonge.narrator: When every sensor screams at once, silence becomes a compass.
mensonge.text:
The sonar shows the portal **above** you — at 200 m depth. Impossible. You're at **440 m**.

Then **below**, at 900 m. Then **to the side**, at 2 m — in the wall.

A maintenance ramp descends to level 2. Marked **EAST EXIT**. The sonar insists: **DO NOT DESCEND.**

Your lamp **flickers** — synced with the ping. As if the relay were **draining** your battery.

**18% · 16% · 19% · —% · 18%**

choices.text: 🔦 Keep the lamp on — follow the strongest contact downward
🫧 Switch off lamp and sonar — descend the ramp blind

audace_puits.title: Echo Shaft
audace_puits.narrator: Following a signal that lies sometimes drops you exactly where you needed to be.
audace_puits.text:
You dive into a service shaft — vertical, narrow.

The « strongest » contact guides you. You **think**.

At **470 m**, the wall opens abruptly. Your lamp — **14%**, trembling — sweeps a **column** of rising bubbles. Not natural. **Mechanical breathing**. A pump still active, somewhere.

The relay ping finally weakens.

And in the silence that follows, a **deep** sound — distant, steady. Not sonar. Not the station.

**Clattering.** Metal on rock. In bulk — the first time you **name** this sound.

choices.text: Leave the shaft — find the source of the noise

lucidite_rampe.title: Silent Ramp
lucidite_rampe.narrator: Without screen or beam, gravity remains — honest, slow, relentless.
lucidite_rampe.text:
You cut everything.

Total black. Only the ramp under your boots — known angle, rough metal, **Fableris marks** carved every ten metres. Down. Down.

You count. Forty marks. Fifty.

When you switch on again: **16%** — the relay no longer steals your battery.

Level 2: flooded storage room. Floating crates. On one, a stencil: **SECTOR 7 — HEAVY EQUIPMENT**.

The **scraping** of gear comes **from below**. Clearer now.

choices.text: Cross the storage toward the east exit

sortie.title: East Exit
sortie.narrator: Leaving a station that lies means finding an ocean that doesn't need to.
sortie.text:
You reach the east exit.

An inclined tunnel — two hundred metres of drilled rock, maybe more. The water is **colder** here. **Denser**.

You emerge.

The HUD finally recalibrates — one line, stable:

**290 m remaining · depth 505 m · heading 214°**

Your lamp: **13%**.

Ahead: no more cliff. A **debris field** — hulls, cranes, containers, wrecks stacked for kilometres, as far as your light reaches.

The **rumble** of scrap metal doesn't stop.

choices.text: Note the depth and move toward the field

fin_sonar.title: Below the Wrecks
fin_sonar.narrator: A machine graveyard underwater doesn't ask permission to grow.
fin_sonar.text:
You stop at the edge.

A twisted crane faces you — broken arm, hook open like a jaw.

The orange glow pulses **between** the wrecks. Closer. **290 metres** still to go.

Your lamp: **12%** — the figure **wavers**: **11% · 13% · 12%**. Your suit sonar stays **off** — you've learned.

The **scraping** **changes direction** in the field — ahead, then left, then **everywhere at once**. You see nothing move. Only the water **shifting** the containers, millimetre by millimetre.

**END EPISODE 4 — Sonar**

*Episode 5: The Debris Field — coming soon*
